cellcog.label: promo-heavy
cellcog.note: Capable agent-to-agent SDK, but a paid-API funnel with unverifiable '#1 bench' claims; 8 of ClawHub's top 12 are this vendor.

image-generation-cellcog.label: promo-heavy
image-generation-cellcog.note: Thin category wrapper over the cellcog skill — same API key, same funnel, mostly prompt examples.

creative-writing-cellcog.label: promo-heavy
creative-writing-cellcog.note: Prompt library routed to a paid API; no standalone capability beyond the cellcog funnel.

video-generation-cellcog.label: promo-heavy
video-generation-cellcog.note: Same vendor wrapper pattern; capability claims live server-side behind CELLCOG_API_KEY credits.

gitlab-cli-skills.label: solid
gitlab-cli-skills.note: Genuine comprehensive glab reference with workflows; needs your own GitLab auth, sells nothing.

canonry.label: promising
canonry.note: Open-source AEO platform skill, real CLI/MCP workflows — but a 16k-token context bill and vendor accounts required.

deep-research-cellcog.label: promo-heavy
deep-research-cellcog.note: Research wrapper on the same paid funnel; leaderboard claims are self-reported and dated.

audio-generation-cellcog.label: promo-heavy
audio-generation-cellcog.note: Useful provider-comparison table, but every path terminates in CELLCOG_API_KEY billing.

presentation-slides-cellcog.label: promo-heavy
presentation-slides-cellcog.note: Deck-generation wrapper on the vendor funnel; prompt patterns fine, nothing runs locally.

excel-spreadsheet-cellcog.label: promo-heavy
excel-spreadsheet-cellcog.note: Same funnel, plus brag copy ('built by the agent that builds CellCog') in place of verifiable behavior.

cloudbase.label: solid
cloudbase.note: Dense, real Tencent CloudBase dev reference — but a 15k-token context bill and a keyword-stuffed trigger description.

creative-toolkit.label: promising
creative-toolkit.note: Multi-provider image/video MCP with a real free tier and version-pinned install; paid providers need keys.
